about.label: About us
about.title: Trust and reliable service since 2012
paragraphs: Voltéo was founded with a simple goal — to provide dependable electrical, heating and plumbing services that homeowners and businesses can trust.

Our team of experienced technicians is committed to delivering safe, efficient and long-lasting solutions for every project. We believe great service starts with professionalism, clear communication and attention to detail.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Explore our most common inquiries about electricity repair, plumbing, and heating services.

items.question: What services does Voltéo offer?
items.answer: We cover electrical repairs and installations, plumbing and leak repair, and full heating system servicing — for both residential and commercial clients.

items.question: Are your technicians certified?
items.answer: Yes. Every technician on our team is fully certified, insured and background-checked before working on any job.

items.question: Do you provide emergency services?
items.answer: Absolutely. We offer 24/7 emergency support with a fixed response time so help is always one call away.

items.question: Can I schedule an appointment online?
items.answer: Yes — use our online form to pick a service and a convenient time, and we'll confirm your booking within minutes.

items.question: How do I get a quote?
items.answer: Request a quote online or by phone. A technician inspects the work on site and gives you transparent, fixed pricing before anything starts.

items.question: Do you offer service warranties?
items.answer: All of our work is backed by a workmanship guarantee. If anything isn't right, we'll come back and put it right at no extra charge.
